snippet.title: Heroes of Anirea - Reveal trailer
snippet.description:
Heroes of Anirea is a tactical, turn-based roguelite where every run tells a unique story shaped by your choices, your strategies, and your heroes. Lead a party of powerful champions through a world torn by elemental forces, mastering a deep combat system that rewards smart positioning, ability synergy, and bold tactics.

Build your team from a diverse cast of heroes, each with unique skills and elemental affinities. Explore procedurally generated maps, face dynamic encounters, and adapt your strategy as new challenges—and opportunities—emerge. Between runs, unlock permanent upgrades and discover hidden lore that deepens your connection to the world of Anirea.

Whether you crave challenging battles, compelling characters, or the thrill of roguelite progression, Heroes of Anirea offers a tactical adventure where no two journeys are the same.

Wishlist now on steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3783410/Heroes_of_Anirea/?utm_source=youtube&utm_content=trailer1_desc&ref=youtube_trailer_desc
